rows.label: tlk44200181_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Teos Aure is an amazing
place, don't you think?

rows.label: tlk44200181_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I read about Alst's cities in books
and encyclopedias, but they don't
seem nearly as pretty as here.

rows.label: tlk44200181_01_msg0003
rows.name:
It's a shame everyone seems so down
lately.

rows.label: tlk44200181_01_msg0004
rows.name:
The old ladies and old men always
look like they're having such a
hard time...

rows.label: tlk44200181_01_msg0005
rows.name:
It's weird, because if they love
the city like I do, they should
be happy, all day, every day!
